item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in identifying spatially heterogeneous Li corrosion, with edge overhang areas losing five times more capacity than centers. The selected-area insulating layer (SAIL) prevents overhang Li plating, cutting corrosion-induced capacity loss by 94%. This reveals a previously overlooked degradation mechanism and offers a simple, scalable strategy to substantially improve calendar-life of Li metal anodes.

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a bio-inspired self-assembly strategy to engineer ordered interface topology in composite solid electrolytes. Its novelty lies in mimicking biological assembly to simultaneously achieve fast ion transport, stable interfaces, and strong dendrite suppression. The significance is a robust electrolyte combining high conductivity, mechanical strength, and excellent cycling stability, advancing safe, high-performance solid-state batteries.

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work reveals that residual crystal water in Prussian blue cathodes acts as a tunable regulator, not merely an impurity, governing electrochemical performance across liquid and halide solid-state sodium batteries.
